comparisonMethod: Canonical payloads from the private inspection API compared as JSON values, recursively ignoring object-key order, against v2 mechanics properties for the same owner. Each v2 candidate may satisfy at most one canonical claim; exact matches are consumed first. Payload-only comparison excludes mechanic identity, evidence, dependencies, context, derivation, review, licensing and source-path semantics.
